name: CLA Studios
hero_subtitle: Another studio complex if one film tour was not enough — optional after Atlas.

overview.title: More Sets Under the Same Desert Light
overview.p1: CLA Studios is a second film complex in the Ouarzazate area. If Atlas Studios already covered your curiosity about sets, you can skip CLA without missing the soul of the trip. If you are here for cinema logistics, a second tour shows how different productions leave different footprints.
overview.p2: Treat it as an optional extra on a film-focused day, not as a substitute for Aït Benhaddou or Skoura.
overview.p3: Confirm opening and tour times in advance — production schedules affect access.

q1.question: Is it the same as Atlas Studios?
q1.answer: Separate complex — similar idea, different sets.

q2.question: Worth it on a short trip?
q2.answer: Only for film enthusiasts; others should prioritise the ksars.

q3.question: Ticketed?
q3.answer: Yes — tours are the usual format.

q4.question: Do I need a guide at CLA Studios?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for history and safe paths on fragile mud brick.

q5.question: Is CLA Studios suitable for families?
q5.answer: Yes with supervision on steps, rooftops and uneven ground.

food.title: Eat in Ouarzazate
food.p1: Plan meals in town. Studio sites are not dining destinations.
food.p2: Keep food planning tied to town, not to the studio gate.
food.li4: Skip a second studio if it means rushing Aït Benhaddou
food.li5: Hotel meal for a quiet end of day

tips.title: Practical Tips for Visiting CLA Studios

1.title: Priority
1.desc: If time is limited, Aït Benhaddou beats a second studio every time.

2.title: Combine carefully
2.desc: Two studio tours in one day can feel repetitive — mix with Taourirt or the museum.

3.title: Confirm access
3.desc: Call or ask your hotel the day before; shoots can close areas.
